why: a header or footer nested inside another block would pass
a container nested more than one level deep would pass
a parse error hidden by errorRecovery would read as a TEMPLATE
an unparseable edit.js would be silently not slotted
a TEMPLATE built by a call or variable would be silently not slotted
a spread or computed key in an entry's attributes would pass
a computed rowSlot value would be dropped silently
an entry without a rowSlot beside entries with one would be dropped silently
mixed row types would be silently not slotted
